title: Final Focal Lengths
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct expressions for the focal lengths f_y and f_x, indicating their relationship and signs.

title: Impulse Approximation
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly apply the impulse approximation to relate the transverse forces to the changes in momentum.

title: Magnetic Field Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student must derive the magnetic field B from the given magnetic scalar potential correctly.

title: Focal Length Calculation
description: Essential Criteria: The student must calculate the focal length f for the given parameters of the quadrupole and the energy of the electrons.

title: Direction of Focusing
description: Important Criteria: The student should explain the difference in focusing behavior in the x and y directions, including the nature of the lens.

title: Units and Constants
description: Optional Criteria: The student should include appropriate units and constants in their calculations to ensure clarity and correctness.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common errors such as sign mistakes in the forces or incorrect application of the Lorentz force.

title: Assumptions Justification
description: Optional Criteria: The student should justify the assumptions made in the impulse approximation and the neglect of transverse speeds.
